## Annotations and labels

Every `nvsnap.io/*` key in non-test Go code. Keys a user or the platform
sets and keys nvsnap writes for its own bookkeeping are listed together;
the description says which. A key with no constant is written inline
where the files column says.

| Key | Constant | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `nvsnap.io/admitted-config` | `AdmittedConfigAnnotation` (internal/webhook/admitted_config.go) | Is the configuration identity (cacheURI) of a pod as admission received it, before the webhook's own patches. |
| `nvsnap.io/cache` | `CacheLabel` (internal/modelvolume/modelvolume.go) | Is the identity key of a compile-cache volume (KindCache). |
| `nvsnap.io/cache-capture` | `CacheCaptureLabel` (internal/webhook/cache_volume.go)<br>`cacheCaptureLabel` (internal/agent/modelvolume_controller.go) | Opts the pod into capture. |
| `nvsnap.io/cache-delta-fingerprint` | `DeltaFingerprintAnnotation` (internal/modelvolume/modelvolume.go) | Records the delta that produced a generation; the same delta proposed again means the engine rewrites those files every start, and the set is marked stable instead. |
| `nvsnap.io/cache-generation` | `GenerationAnnotation` (internal/modelvolume/modelvolume.go) | On a complete set primary counts refreshes; absent means 1. |
| `nvsnap.io/cache-group-size` | `CacheGroupSizeAnnotation` (internal/modelvolume/modelvolume.go) | Is how many ranks the set must contain. |
| `nvsnap.io/cache-key` | `CacheKeyLabel` (internal/modelvolume/modelvolume.go) | Cache set: the compile caches of one configuration, all ranks in one volume. |
| `nvsnap.io/cache-ordinal` | `CacheOrdinalAnnotation` (internal/modelvolume/modelvolume.go) | Is the pod's rank in its group. |
| `nvsnap.io/cache-owners` | `CacheOwnersAnnotation` (internal/modelvolume/modelvolume.go) | On a complete set primary says its files keep the owners and modes the engine gave them (CacheOwnersKept). |
| `nvsnap.io/cache-rank-bytes` | `CacheRankBytesAnnotation` (internal/modelvolume/modelvolume.go) |  |
| `nvsnap.io/cache-rank-delta` | `CacheRankDeltaAnnotation` (internal/modelvolume/modelvolume.go) | Marks a warm rank whose cachedir holds files the seeded set did not have; the bytes and a fingerprint of the new paths ride along. |
| `nvsnap.io/cache-rank-delta-bytes` | `CacheRankDeltaBytesAnnotation` (internal/modelvolume/modelvolume.go) |  |
| `nvsnap.io/cache-rank-delta-fingerprint` | `CacheRankDeltaFingerprintAnnotation` (internal/modelvolume/modelvolume.go) |  |
| `nvsnap.io/cache-rank-ready` | `CacheRankReadyAnnotation` (internal/modelvolume/modelvolume.go) | Is set by the agent on the pod's node once the rank's cache tree has settled; CacheRankBytesAnnotation is its size. |
| `nvsnap.io/cache-refresh-stable` | `RefreshStableAnnotation` (internal/modelvolume/modelvolume.go) | Stops further refreshes of a set. |
| `nvsnap.io/cache-refreshed-from` | `RefreshedFromAnnotation` (internal/modelvolume/modelvolume.go) | Names the primary a refreshed generation was collected to replace. |
| `nvsnap.io/cache-salt` | `CacheSaltAnnotation` (internal/rootfsonly/composer.go) | Lets a chart or operator fold an arbitrary value into the capture and cache identity. |
| `nvsnap.io/cache-seed-generation` | `CacheSeedGenerationAnnotation` (internal/modelvolume/modelvolume.go) | On a seeded pod names the generation it was seeded from. |
| `nvsnap.io/cache-subpath` | `CacheSubpathAnnotation` (internal/webhook/cache_volume.go)<br>`cacheSubpathAnnotation` (internal/agent/modelvolume_controller.go) | Is the cache subtree inside that volume. |
| `nvsnap.io/cache-uri` | `CacheURIAnnotation` (internal/webhook/cache_volume.go)<br>`cacheURIAnnotation` (internal/agent/modelvolume_controller.go) | Carries the cache identity (config hash, ordinal). |
| `nvsnap.io/cache-volume` | `CacheVolumeAnnotation` (internal/webhook/cache_volume.go)<br>`cacheVolumeAnnotation` (internal/agent/modelvolume_controller.go) | Names the emptyDir volume holding the cache. |
| `nvsnap.io/capture` | `CaptureLabel` (internal/webhook/mutate.go)<br>`DefaultCaptureLabel` (internal/rootfsonly/watcher.go)<br>`rootfsCaptureLabel` (internal/server/server.go) | Is the pod-label key the agent watches for capture candidates. |
| `nvsnap.io/capture-hash` | `CMAnnotationHash` (internal/checkpointstore/cmregistry.go) | Is the full sha256 hex; annotations have a per-object 256KiB total cap so 64 chars is fine. |
| `nvsnap.io/checkpoint` | `railsAnnoCheckpoint` (internal/agent/rails_fetch.go) |  |
| `nvsnap.io/checkpoint-on-warm` | `CheckpointOnWarmAnnotation` (internal/podtimings/podtimings.go) | Is the annotation key NVCA's Hook A stamps for Cold pods so Hook B's reconciler knows to capture them after readiness. |
| `nvsnap.io/ckpt-size` | `annCkptSize` (internal/server/manifests.go) |  |
| `nvsnap.io/cold-start` | `ColdStartAnnotation` (internal/election/election.go) | Is stamped on a follower whose leader failed; the pod is recreated by its controller and re-admitted. |
| `nvsnap.io/criu-capture` | `criuCaptureAnnotation` (internal/agent/criu_group.go) | Opts a multi-pod instance into the capture. |
| `nvsnap.io/criu-group` | `CRIUGroupAnnotation` (internal/webhook/criu_group.go) | Names the group record a placeholder restores from; CRIUGroupOrdinalAnnotation and CRIUGroupSizeAnnotation place it in the instance. |
| `nvsnap.io/criu-group-companion` | `CRIUGroupCompanionAnnotation` (internal/webhook/criu_group.go) | Marks a placeholder that restores a companion of the instance: a pod without GPUs that its GPU ranks were connected to (an etcd, a NATS), captured and restored with them. |
| `nvsnap.io/criu-group-ordinal` | `CRIUGroupOrdinalAnnotation` (internal/webhook/criu_group.go) |  |
| `nvsnap.io/criu-group-size` | `CRIUGroupSizeAnnotation` (internal/webhook/criu_group.go) |  |
| `nvsnap.io/criu-restore` | `CRIURestoreAnnotation` (internal/webhook/criu_restore.go)<br>`criuRestoreAnnotation` (internal/rootfsonly/watcher.go) | Marks a CRIU restore placeholder (webhook.CRIURestoreAnnotation; that package imports this one). |
| `nvsnap.io/criu-restore-container` | `CRIURestoreContainerAnnotation` (internal/webhook/criu_restore.go) |  |
| `nvsnap.io/criu-restored` | `CRIURestoredAnnotation` (internal/webhook/criu_group.go) | Marks a placeholder the agent restored into, so an agent that restarts does not restore into it again. |
| `nvsnap.io/deadline` | `DeadlineAnnotation` (internal/election/election.go) | Is the RFC3339 time after which the reconciler treats the leader as failed even if its pod is still around. |
| `nvsnap.io/demo-name` | `annDemoName` (internal/server/manifests.go) |  |
| `nvsnap.io/desc` | `annDesc` (internal/server/manifests.go) |  |
| `nvsnap.io/election-id` | `ElectionIDAnnotation` (internal/election/election.go) | On the leader pod is the id the webhook minted at admission and used as the Lease holder. |
| `nvsnap.io/function-version-id` | `FunctionVersionIDAnnotation` (internal/podtimings/podtimings.go) | Is the annotation key NVCA's Hook A stamps with the function-version id so downstream tools can group + summarize without re-deriving from labels. |
| `nvsnap.io/gated` | `GatedLabel` (internal/election/election.go) | Is "true" while a follower holds the scheduling gate. |
| `nvsnap.io/gpus` | `annGPUs` (internal/server/manifests.go) |  |
| `nvsnap.io/gpushare` | `GPUShareAnnotation` (internal/webhook/gpushare.go) | Opts a pod in. |
| `nvsnap.io/gpushare-fabric` | `GPUShareFabricAnnotation` (internal/webhook/gpushare.go) | Marks a pod whose GPU memory is shared with pods on other nodes over multi-node NVLink. |
| `nvsnap.io/hash` | `HashAnnotation` (internal/election/election.go)<br>`HashLabel` (internal/election/election.go)<br>`stampedHashAnnotation` (internal/rootfsonly/watcher.go) | Carries the full cache hash the webhook composed at admission. |
| `nvsnap.io/hash-short` | `labelHashShort` (internal/checkpointstore/promoter_shared.go) |  |
| `nvsnap.io/inject` | `InjectLabel` (internal/webhook/mutate.go) | On a pod (or, via the registration's namespaceSelector, on its namespace) set to InjectDisabled opts the pod out of every nvsnap mutation. |
| `nvsnap.io/kind` | `CMLabelKind` (internal/checkpointstore/cmregistry.go)<br>`LeaseKindLabel` (internal/election/election.go) | Marks ConfigMaps managed by nvsnap so list/cleanup queries can filter them. |
| `nvsnap.io/last-used` | `LastUsedAnnotation` (internal/modelvolume/modelvolume.go) | On a primary PV is the RFC 3339 time a pod last admitted against it (or it completed). |
| `nvsnap.io/leader-id` | `LeaderIDAnnotation` (internal/election/election.go) |  |
| `nvsnap.io/leader-namespace` | `LeaderNamespaceAnnotation` (internal/election/election.go) | And LeaderIDAnnotation on the Lease name the leader pod (namespace + election id) so its liveness can be checked. |
| `nvsnap.io/lease-kind` | inline: internal/agent/replication_poll.go, internal/checkpointstore/percapture_pvc.go |  |
| `nvsnap.io/model` | `IdentityLabel` (internal/modelvolume/modelvolume.go)<br>`annModel` (internal/server/manifests.go) | Is the short identity key on claims, PVs and pods. |
| `nvsnap.io/model-capture` | `CaptureLabel` (internal/modelvolume/modelvolume.go) | Is "true" on a pod whose engine downloads an artifact nvsnap has no download recipe for (a chart script pulling an NGC model) into a pod volume. |
| `nvsnap.io/model-capture-volume` | `CaptureVolumeAnnotation` (internal/modelvolume/modelvolume.go) | Names the pod volume the engine downloads into. |
| `nvsnap.io/model-complete` | `CompleteLabel` (internal/modelvolume/modelvolume.go) | Is "true" on the writer claim once the download exited 0. |
| `nvsnap.io/model-download-init` | `DownloadInitAnnotation` (internal/modelvolume/modelvolume.go) | On a writer names the init container whose exit 0 means the download completed. |
| `nvsnap.io/model-failed` | `FailedAnnotation` (internal/modelvolume/modelvolume.go) | On the failure record carries the reason. |
| `nvsnap.io/model-landing` | `LandingAnnotation` (internal/modelvolume/modelvolume.go) | On a pod records the mount path the model must appear at, for the agent's bind. |
| `nvsnap.io/model-pending` | `PendingLabel` (internal/modelvolume/modelvolume.go) | Is "true" on a Block-mode reader that still needs the agent to bind the volume into its emptyDir. |
| `nvsnap.io/model-role` | `RoleLabel` (internal/modelvolume/modelvolume.go) | Is writer \| reader on pods. |
| `nvsnap.io/model-source-namespace` | `SourceNamespaceLabel` (internal/modelvolume/modelvolume.go) | On the primary PV records the namespace the download Job ran in. |
| `nvsnap.io/model-staging-volume` | `StagingAnnotation` (internal/modelvolume/modelvolume.go) | On a Block-mode download Job names the emptyDir volume the download landed in; the agent on the Job's node copies it into the sized claim. |
| `nvsnap.io/model-uri` | `IdentityAnnotation` (internal/modelvolume/modelvolume.go) | Is the full model URI. |
| `nvsnap.io/mount-holder` | inline: internal/checkpointstore/mount_holder.go |  |
| `nvsnap.io/namespace` | `labelNamespace` (internal/checkpointstore/promoter_shared.go) |  |
| `nvsnap.io/path` | `annPath` (internal/server/manifests.go) |  |
| `nvsnap.io/per-capture` | inline: internal/checkpointstore/percapture_pvc.go, internal/checkpointstore/promoter_shared.go, internal/checkpointstore/promoter_snapshot.go |  |
| `nvsnap.io/port` | `annPort` (internal/server/manifests.go) |  |
| `nvsnap.io/rails-for` | `railsLabelFor` (internal/agent/rails_fetch.go) |  |
| `nvsnap.io/restore-failure-threshold` | inline: internal/manifests/restore.go |  |
| `nvsnap.io/restore-from` | `RestoreFromAnnotation` (internal/podtimings/podtimings.go)<br>`RestoreFromAnnotation` (internal/webhook/mutate.go) | Is the annotation key NVCA's Hook A stamps to tell NvSnap's restore webhook which checkpoint to inject. |
| `nvsnap.io/restored` | inline: internal/webhook/criu_restore.go |  |
| `nvsnap.io/role` | `RoleAnnotation` (internal/election/election.go)<br>`ViewRoleLabel` (internal/modelvolume/modelvolume.go) | Records the admission decision: leader, follower or restore. |
| `nvsnap.io/short-hash` | `CMLabelShortHash` (internal/checkpointstore/cmregistry.go) | Is the 32-char short hash (128 bits), suitable for label selectors. |
| `nvsnap.io/source-engine` | `LabelSourceEngine` (internal/checkpointstore/cmregistry.go) | Is the engine type ("vllm", "sglang", "trtllm", "nim"). |
| `nvsnap.io/source-image-base` | `LabelSourceImageBase` (internal/checkpointstore/cmregistry.go) | Is the base image name (no registry, no tag, DNS-label-sanitized). |
| `nvsnap.io/source-namespace` | `LabelSourceNamespace` (internal/checkpointstore/cmregistry.go) | Identifies the originating pod's namespace. |
| `nvsnap.io/source-pv` | `SourcePVLabel` (internal/modelvolume/modelvolume.go) | On a read-only view names the primary it was minted from, so liveness and retirement work per generation. |
| `nvsnap.io/target-node` | `TargetNodeAnnotation` (internal/webhook/mutate.go) | Overrides the auto-pin to manifest.CapturedOnNodes. |
| `nvsnap.io/v1alpha1` | inline: internal/server/server.go |  |
| `nvsnap.io/volume-bytes` | `BytesAnnotation` (internal/modelvolume/modelvolume.go) | On a primary PV is the byte count of the tree it holds, measured at completion. |
| `nvsnap.io/wait-for-cache` | `GateName` (internal/election/election.go) | Is the schedulingGates entry a follower carries until the capture for its hash is promoted. |

## Environment variables

Every environment variable an nvsnap binary reads. "Chart" marks the
ones the Helm chart sets on the agent DaemonSet
(`deploy/helm/nvsnap/templates/agent-daemonset.yaml`); the others are
set by hand through `agent.extraEnv`, or by the pod spec that runs the
binary.

## Agent HTTP API

The routes of the node agent (`internal/agent/agent.go`). The server's
API is specified in [openapi.yaml](../internal/server/openapi.yaml).

| Route | Methods | Handler |
|---|---|---|
| `/metrics` | GET | `metrics.Handler()` |
| `/health` | GET | `healthHandler` |
| `/v1/checkpoint` | POST | `checkpointHandler` |
| `/v1/gpushare/group-checkpoint` | POST | `groupCheckpointHandler`: Multi-node gpushare: a group checkpoint drives one fabric session; the fabric routes serve this node's pods in a session to that driver. |
| `/v1/gpushare/fabric/{session}/{namespace}/{pod}` | GET | `fabricStateHandler` |
| `/v1/gpushare/fabric/{session}/{namespace}/{pod}/verdict` | PUT | `fabricVerdictHandler` |
| `/v1/gpushare/fabric/{session}/{namespace}/{pod}/in` | PUT | `fabricInHandler` |
| `/v1/gpushare/fabric/{session}/{namespace}/{pod}/unlock` | PUT | `fabricUnlockHandler` |
| `/v1/gpushare/group-restore` | POST | `groupRestoreHandler` |
| `/v1/restore` | POST | `restoreHandler` |
| `/v1/pods/{namespace}/{pod}/peers` | GET | `peersHandler`: Instance companions (criu_companion.go): a rank's connections, and the continue of a companion restored stopped. |
| `/v1/capture-preflight/pod/{namespace}/{pod}` | GET | `podPreflightHandler`: Capture preflight (capture_preflight.go): an instance's report, and the host checks of a pod on this node. |
| `/v1/capture-preflight/{namespace}/{pod}` | GET | `instancePreflightHandler` |
| `/v1/bundles/{id}` | GET | `bundleHandler`: A node bundle version, for a peer whose restore placeholder needs it (bundle_versions.go). |
| `/v1/group-freeze/{session}/{namespace}/{pod}` | GET, POST | `freezeHandler` |
| `/v1/restore/manifest` | POST | `getPlaceholderManifestHandler` |
| `/v1/checkpoints` | GET | `listCheckpointsHandler` |
| `/v1/cache-rank/{key}/{ordinal}` | GET | `cacheRankHandler`: A ready rank's cache tree for the agent collecting its set (bearer-guarded like every agent-to-agent route). |
| `/v1/containers` | GET | `listContainersHandler` |
| `/v1/gpu/processes` | GET | `gpuProcessesHandler` |
| `/v1/checkpoints/{id}` | DELETE | `deleteCheckpointHandler` |
| `/v1/checkpoints/{id}/files` | GET | `listCheckpointFilesHandler` |
| `/v1/checkpoints/{id}/file` | GET | `readCheckpointFileHandler` |
| `/v1/checkpoints/{id}/manifest` | GET | `checkpointManifestHandler`: Phase 5d.1: peer-fanout manifest endpoint. |
| `/v1/checkpoints/{id}/ensure-local` | POST | `ensureLocalHandler`: Phase 5d.1: cascading fetch entrypoint. |
| `/debug/pprof/` | any | `pprof.Index`: Pprof — for diagnosing cascade throughput on the actual cluster. |
| `/debug/pprof/cmdline` | any | `pprof.Cmdline` |
| `/debug/pprof/profile` | any | `pprof.Profile` |
| `/debug/pprof/symbol` | any | `pprof.Symbol` |
| `/debug/pprof/trace` | any | `pprof.Trace` |
| `/debug/pprof/goroutine` | any | `pprof.Handler("goroutine")` |
| `/debug/pprof/heap` | any | `pprof.Handler("heap")` |
| `/debug/pprof/allocs` | any | `pprof.Handler("allocs")` |
| `/debug/pprof/block` | any | `pprof.Handler("block")` |
| `/debug/pprof/mutex` | any | `pprof.Handler("mutex")` |
| `/debug/pprof/threadcreate` | any | `pprof.Handler("threadcreate")` |
| `/v1/captures/{hash}/manifest` | GET | `captureManifestHandler`: Rootfs-only multi-GPU peer endpoints. |
| `/v1/captures/{hash}/file` | GET | `captureFileHandler` |
| `/v1/captures/{hash}/ensure-local` | POST | `ensureCaptureLocalHandler`: Rootfs cascade fan-out trigger (GH #114). |
| `/v1/replicate/{hash}` | POST | `replicateHandler`: Cross-cluster pull-through (docs/design/cross-cluster-replication.md). |
| `/v1/restore/overlay` | POST | `prepareRestoreOverlayHandler`: Nvsnap#194: per-restore-pod OverlayFS unions on top of the rootfs capture's read-only tree, so workloads that write into captured cache dirs (vLLM compile cache, etc.) stop crashing with EROFS. Routes are an out-of-band trigger for the… |
| `/v1/restore/overlay/{pod-uid}` | DELETE | `cleanupRestoreOverlayHandler` |
| `/v1/restore/prep` | POST | `startRestorePrepHandler`: Nvsnap#202: async overlay-prep for nvsnap-mount-prep init container. |
| `/v1/restore/prep/{pod-uid}` | GET | `statusRestorePrepHandler` |
| `/v1/restore/prep/{pod-uid}` | DELETE | `cleanupRestorePrepHandler` |
